about: Every module in packages/quac/src/parse/ and packages/quac/src/generate/ has a Python counterpart in quac_server/ of the same name, or is listed under modules with the reason it has none. A module with a counterpart exports each of its JavaScript functions under the Python name, or lists the function under functions with its reason. tests/test_parity.py checks both. Under departures, a function that does what its JavaScript counterpart does in a different way, and why.

modules.parse/parseBrandColour.ts: The project's Brand colour, which an application reads from the parsed project; no catalogue field carries it.
modules.parse/parseDataDefinedEditable.ts: A field's data-defined editable expression, for quac:editable_when, which is not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseExtent.ts: The map canvas extent, for quac:initial_view, which is not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseFormLayout.ts: The form layout, for quac:form_order, quac:in_form, quac:visible_when and quac:editable_when, which are not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseGetProjectSettings.ts: Reads a GetProjectSettings response, the other QGIS Server producer's input. The plugin reads the project's text.
modules.parse/parseMeasurement.ts: The project's area and distance units, for quac:measurement, which is not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseMergin.ts: The Mergin Maps plugin's filters, for quac:filters, which is not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseProjectVariables.ts: The project's variables, which an application reads from the parsed project; no catalogue field carries them.
modules.parse/parseRelations.ts: The project's relations, for quac:related_to and value relations, which are not in the first release.
modules.parse/parseStyle.ts: A layer's styles. The plugin's first release serves no style.
modules.parse/qgisExpression.ts: Reads QGIS expressions, for defaults, constraints and conditional fields, which are not in the first release.
modules.parse/qtDateFormat.ts: Qt date patterns, for quac:date_format and for evaluating expressions, neither in the first release.
modules.parse/qtRegex.ts: Qt regular expressions, for evaluating expressions, which the first release does not do.
modules.generate/arcgisStacCatalogue.ts: The ArcGIS producer: another kind of source.
modules.generate/externalStacCatalogue.ts: Reads a STAC catalogue from somewhere else: another kind of source.
modules.generate/fileLayerCollection.ts: The Collection for a single data file: another kind of source.
modules.generate/folderStacCatalogue.ts: The folder of data files producer: another kind of source.
modules.generate/ogcFeaturesStacCatalogue.ts: The OGC API Features producer: another kind of source.
modules.generate/qmlForLayer.ts: Rebuilds a layer's QML style. The plugin's first release serves no style.
modules.generate/wfsStacCatalogue.ts: The WFS producer: another kind of source.

departures.parse/parseDataSource.ts: parse_data_source reads every source of the wms and xyzvectortiles providers as kind image, whatever its address; the JavaScript reads it as wms, wmts or xyz, or unsupported where the URL class refuses its address. In a served catalogue the kind decides only whether a layer is editable, and a layer of either provider is an image, which QGIS Server does not publish for WFS, so the server route makes it read-only either way. Vectoria chose this on 2026-11-07 over copying the URL class's rules into Python.
